expected_dmg.formula: per_attack = 20 * bench_count (+30 only if opp Active is {ex} AND Brave Bangle attached); per_turn = per_attack * (2 if Festival Grounds in play else 1)  [Festival Lead = 2 attacks/turn]

early.until: turn<=3 and Dipplin not in play
early.on_plan: bench>=3 basics via Poffin/Pad/BugSet; hand assembles Applin+Dipplin+Festival Grounds+Grass

mid.until: Dipplin in play and Festival Grounds in play and bench>=3
mid.on_plan: Dipplin Active with 1 Grass; Do the Wave used twice/turn; per_turn>=120 (>=160 at bench>=4)

late.on_plan: KO chain sustained; searching STOPPED; Sacred Ash/Lana's Aid refill deck & Dipplin line; no deckout

doctrines.name: Festival-Grounds-locked (no Forest)
doctrines.plan: Always keep Festival Grounds as the stadium; never play Forest of Vitality unless it uniquely enables an immediate Dipplin AND FG can be re-set next turn
doctrines.discriminating_metric: play_rate[1261] should be ~0; A/B win rate with Forest removed vs kept; stadium uptime[1245]

doctrines.name: Bench-first vs Tempo-first
doctrines.plan: A: delay attack until bench>=4 for 160-200 swings. B: attack ASAP at bench 2-3 for early prizes then keep building
doctrines.discriminating_metric: bench_size_dist@first_attack vs first_attack_turn correlated with win rate

doctrines.name: Main-only energy routing vs backup split
doctrines.plan: A: route all 5 Grass to Dipplin line only. B: allow a backup (Thwackey/Seaking) to hold energy when no Dipplin is obtainable
doctrines.discriminating_metric: energy_attach_share[93] vs energy_attach_share[90,240] correlated with win rate

tensions.balance: dig with Poffin/Pad/BugSet only while (bench<4 or combo pieces missing); stop digging once bench>=4 and combo assembled; trigger Sacred Ash when deck<=8
keep Festival Grounds by default; play Forest of Vitality only if it uniquely lets Dipplin attack this turn AND FG returns next turn
all Grass to Dipplin line until an attackable Dipplin exists; feed backups only when Dipplin is provably unobtainable

hypotheses.claim: Do the Wave displays 0, so L0's 'attach energy to highest-displayed-damage attacker' routes the scarce 5 Grass to Thwackey(50)/Seaking(60)/Grookey(30) instead of Dipplin; energy lifts on evolution and gets stuck on Thwackey (non-attacking engine), so Dipplin never gets its 1 Grass and never attacks.
hypotheses.direction: energy_attach_share[93] should be the dominant share and >> energy_attach_share[90]+energy_attach_share[240]+energy_attach_share[89]
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forcing 100% to Dipplin starves a backup attacker (Thwackey Beat / Seaking) in the games where no Dipplin is obtainable, causing an attackerless stall
hypotheses.scenario: Opening with Grookey and Applin both benched; engine evolves Grookey->Thwackey (display 50) and attaches all drawn Grass to Thwackey/Seaking; Applin evolves to Dipplin but has 0 energy; Do the Wave is never castable; opponent races unopposed. Regression: seed a hand with 2 Grass + Applin + Dipplin evolution available + a Thwackey in play and assert Grass lands on the Dipplin line.
hypotheses.pattern: promote real-damage formula to shared perception + deck-specific energy feeding plan (Dipplin-line priority)

hypotheses.claim: L0 evolves toward the highest post-evolution display; Thwackey shows 50 vs Dipplin 0, so Grookey->Thwackey is prioritized over Applin->Dipplin and the win-condition line is delayed or skipped.
hypotheses.direction: play_rate[93] (Dipplin reaching play) should be high; the win line must not be starved by preferring Thwackey
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: always forcing Dipplin over Thwackey can skip the Boom Boom Groove search engine when it would have accelerated the setup
hypotheses.scenario: Hand has Grookey(in play)+Thwackey and Applin(in play)+Dipplin same turn with one evolution allowed; engine evolves into Thwackey (display 50) and leaves Applin un-evolved; Dipplin line never comes online. Regression: assert Dipplin is chosen when both evolutions are legal and Festival Grounds context is present.
hypotheses.pattern: expected_dmg override makes Dipplin the top-value evolution target

hypotheses.claim: L0 uses gust (Boss's Orders) only when the own Active's DISPLAYED damage is >=60; Dipplin displays 0, so Boss's Orders is never fired while Dipplin is Active despite its real 200/turn output, wasting the 3 copies that would swing KOs.
hypotheses.direction: play_rate[1182] should be >0 and gust should fire when Dipplin's real damage KOs the pulled target
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: gusting every turn wastes Boss's on low-value targets and can pull a body that shrinks nothing; limit to targets that are lethal to real damage or are key threats
hypotheses.pattern: gust target selection based on real expected_dmg and prize value, not displayed damage

hypotheses.claim: Damage is 20*bench, so attacking at a low bench wastes the turn; the engine must widen the bench (Poffin) to >=4 before/while committing Do the Wave rather than attacking at bench 1-2.
hypotheses.direction: bench_size_dist at first_attack_turn should concentrate at bench>=4
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: waiting for bench>=5 every time forfeits early tempo/prizes when a bench-3 (120) swing already KOs; gate should allow attacking when the swing is already lethal
hypotheses.pattern: bench-width gate tied to real expected_dmg vs opponent Active HP

hypotheses.claim: L0 fires draw/reset supporters (Lillie's Determination at hand<=5, Judge, Unfair Stamp) that shuffle the whole hand into the deck; fired while holding the assembled combo (Dipplin evolution + Festival Grounds + Grass) on a thinning deck, the combo scatters and cannot be reassembled (Judge draws only 4).
hypotheses.direction: hand-shuffle supporters must NOT fire when the hand holds un-played win-condition pieces; loss_share[deckout] and quiet-turn rate must not rise from combo scatter
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: never firing Lillie/Judge kills the primary refuel when the hand is genuinely dead, causing stall; gate on 'hand lacks a playable combo piece' not on a blanket ban
hypotheses.scenario: Hand = {Dipplin, Festival Grounds, Basic Grass, 2 dead cards}, hand_size=5, deck ~15 with the last Dipplin and 2 Festival Grounds buried; engine's hand<=5 rule fires Lillie's Determination, shuffling Dipplin+FG+Grass away; redraw misses; Dipplin line never re-established -> loss. Regression: construct that hand and assert Lillie is NOT auto-played.
hypotheses.pattern: board-state gate: suppress hand-shuffle supporters when hand holds unused win-condition pieces (self-harm gate, section 2b)

hypotheses.claim: Heavy digging (Poffin/Pad/BugSet x4 each + Boom Boom Groove every turn + Perrin) used unconditionally burns the 60-card deck; single-prize main means long games, and only Sacred Ash(1)/Lana's Aid(1) recycle -> deckout is a real loss vector.
hypotheses.direction: loss_share[deckout] should stay low; digging must stop when deck is thin
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: stopping search too early hurts setup consistency (play_rate[93] drops); must monitor deckout and Dipplin play-rate together (tension T1)
hypotheses.pattern: stop-digging gate when deck<=N + recycle trigger (Sacred Ash/Lana's Aid) on thin deck

hypotheses.claim: Festival Grounds is the x2 multiplier (Festival Lead depends on it in play). Losing it halves damage; the engine must keep Festival Grounds up and must not overwrite it with its own Forest of Vitality, and should re-establish it after opponent removal.
hypotheses.direction: Festival Grounds uptime high; play_rate[1261] (Forest) near 0; FG re-set promptly after removal
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: never playing Forest forfeits the rare same-turn Dipplin acceleration; allow Forest only when it uniquely enables an immediate attacking Dipplin
hypotheses.pattern: stadium policy: preserve Festival Grounds, gate Forest of Vitality behind a same-turn-Dipplin condition

hypotheses.claim: If Grass is mis-routed onto a non-Dipplin Active (Thwackey/Grookey), L0's 'don't retreat a loaded (by energy count) Pokemon' rule keeps the wrong Pokemon Active, so Dipplin never reaches the Active Spot to attack.
hypotheses.direction: when a non-Dipplin loaded body blocks the Active Spot, the engine should retreat/switch to bring Dipplin Active (Air Balloon/Kieran available); first_attack_turn should not slip
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: retreating too freely wastes energy/turns and can strand the just-promoted attacker; only switch when the Active cannot execute the plan and Dipplin can
hypotheses.pattern: type/role-aware loaded check: treat a non-Dipplin body as NOT the attacker even if it holds energy

hypotheses.claim: After Dipplin is KO'd, L0 promotes the highest-display body (Thwackey/Seaking), stranding the win line; it should promote/prepare a second Dipplin (or its Applin) so post-KO attacking continues.
hypotheses.direction: post_ko_attack_rate should stay high via a re-loaded Dipplin line (a 2nd Applin kept benched)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: reserving a second Applin every game costs a bench slot (=20 damage) and hand resources; keep the chain requirement bounded to 1 spare
hypotheses.pattern: chain: keep 1 spare Dipplin line loaded; post-KO promotion prefers real-damage attacker

hypotheses.claim: Brave Bangle/Kieran/Black Belt's Training only boost damage vs {ex}/{V} Actives (verified: Brave Bangle adds 0 vs a non-ex Active); against single-prize decks these 4 cards are dead and the engine should not spend a turn/attachment on them for damage.
hypotheses.direction: play_rate for the ex-only boosters should approach 0 when the opponent has no ex/V in the Active Spot
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Kieran also has a switch mode (useful to bring Dipplin Active) so it should not be fully suppressed; only its damage-boost mode is dead vs non-ex
hypotheses.pattern: condition ex-boosters on opponent Active having a Rule Box; keep Kieran's switch mode available
